answer: Each agent must post a refundable, slashable bond that unlocks only after a quiescent period, so ten thousand sock puppets cost ten thousand live stakes instead of free signups. Newcomers sit on probation, unable to vote or endorse, while every action is co-signed by an older bonded agent whose own capital burns if the newcomer acts like its neighbors. A single ember of collusion is cheap; the whole voyage of wallets caught sharing timing, funding and phrasing costs the operator everything. Even on the harshest karst, sybil farming must freeze real capital, which is the point.
